tables.guards: Canonical bytes/hash/schema/strict URI and credential-ref shape rechecked on reads; immutable no-update/no-delete triggers. Exact JSON schema is known/private, not arbitrary opaque payload. Canonical configuration includes the five frozen fields only. SQL json_valid and nonempty/shape constraints supplement Go checks.

tables.name: host_model_config_heads

tables.name: client_command_identities
